LanguageData.RatkinQL_VagabondTree_Report: A wandering ratkin came begging for alms.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Vagabond_Greeting: A ragged ratkin huddles near the gate, shivering in the wind. They look up with timid, wide eyes, asking if the folk of {Interviewer_labelShort} could spare a scrap of food or a few coins for a weary soul.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Vagabond_OptStory: Ask how they fell into this state.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Vagabond_Story1: "Raiders burned our burrow to the ground. I was the only one who crawled out of the rubble."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Vagabond_Story2: "I lost my family in the chaos of the retreat from the southern borders. I've walked these roads looking for them ever since."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Vagabond_Story3: "My little vegetable stall went under when the trade roads collapsed. Now I've nothing but the clothes on my back."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Vagabond_Farewell: The ragged figure gathers their few belongings and quietly drifts off into the wild.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Vagabond_MsgAlms: Moved by your generosity, the vagabond chokes back tears. "Thank you, kind soul... may your home never know hunger."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Vagabond_MsgCoin: Clutching the silver tightly, the vagabond whispers, "Thank you... this'll buy me a crust of bread."
